Draft · For the poet’s review

Proposed reading selection & literary timeline

These proposals await the poet’s approval. This page is public by direct link, but is not listed in the website navigation.

Start Reading draft for the poet

Proposed five-piece introduction. This selection and the descriptions below are editorial suggestions, not the poet’s endorsement. Shared here for review; not part of the main site navigation.

  1. A Poet Has No Land — Begin with his idea of poetry beyond borders.
  2. Life in an idyllic village — Return to the village and family world of his childhood.
  3. My Romance with Radio — Follow a familiar object into a life of listening and memory.
  4. Jayant Mahapatra: The Doyen of Poetry — Meet a poet through another poet’s recollections.
  5. Learning the Lessons of Finance — Discover the public-service experience alongside the literary life.

Decisions for the poet

Confirm or replace these five choices and their order. Decide whether the introduction should include more poetry and less memoir. Approve the short descriptions before publication. No article text needs to change.

Literary timeline draft for review

A starting chronology of documented publications and appearances. These dates describe the linked publications or recordings, not first book editions or career appointments. Shared here for review; not part of the main site navigation.

  • August 2019 — Boloji publishes Bhaskaranand Jha Bhaskar’s review of A House Within. Review dated 24 August.
  • February 2020 — Setu’s Voices Within presents “Words Today,” “Sunflower” and “Last Night.” Poetry selection.
  • March 2021 — “The Lost Photos” appears in INNSÆI, Volume II, Issue 3, printed pages 64–65. Journal issue.
  • March 2022 — Shalandi Sahitya publishes the Odia interview with Sahadev Sahu; its interview index records 23 March. Interview.
  • December 2023 — Literia Insight publishes the Lit Fest conversation with Nitish Raj on 29 December. Recording.
  • November 2024 — HolisticConversations publishes a conversation about the poet’s life and public service. The recording’s detail panel gives 2 November; earlier search metadata showed 3 November. Use month only pending resolution. Recording.
  • July 2025 — Setu publishes a poetry selection including “Forgotten Dreams.” Poetry selection.
  • February 2026 — Pyssum Literaria publishes Akanksha Pandey’s review of Rendezvous with Dreams on 26 February. Review.
  • August 2026 — A conversation with Pradeep Pramanik explores Odisha’s tourism potential. The upload timestamp falls on 9 August in India. Recording.

Complete before publication

Ask the poet for first-edition dates and title pages of his books; the founding date of Kabita Live; the first Toshali Literature Festival; and dated evidence for significant awards. Those milestones would give the chronology a stronger shape than a list of online appearances alone.

Confirm the selection, spellings and any dates the poet wishes to clarify. The earlier catalogue records evidence and unresolved leads; no inferred dates or new biographical claims are included here.

Article images

Proposed direction: keep original photographic or editorial images for articles, with consistent sizing and framing. Keep watercolor for the portrait and decorative artwork. Image revisions are deferred for discussion with the poet; current live images are unchanged.
